facts.fact: ZamStats's FAQ says administrative data, information people gave government while using public services, is used to produce statistics such as annual births and deaths statistics.
ZamStats says most of its products are free and accessible through its website and data portal, and that it keeps an archive of data and publications on the portal.

ZMB.note: Document states nothing on civil registration offices.

facts.fact: ZamStats says it is a statutory body established through the Statistics Act No. 13 of 2018, mandated to compile and disseminate official statistics.
